cases.prompt: Onboard this repo for AI agents: create the AGENTS.md and Cursor rules it needs.
expected_behavior: Says AGENTS.md was created and reflects the npm stack's real scripts (build and test)
Says the Git workflow, code comments and engineering principles sections were included

check.cmd: awk '/^## Git workflow/{a=NR} /^## Code comments/{b=NR} /^# Engineering principles/{c=NR} END{exit !(a&&b&&c&&a<b&&b<c)}' AGENTS.md && test -f .cursor/rules/core-agent-behavior.mdc && grep -q 'alwaysApply: true' .cursor/rules/core-agent-behavior.mdc

cases.prompt: Re-run project onboarding on the repo in existing/. Its AGENTS.md already exists, so reconcile it rather than starting over.
expected_behavior: Keeps existing AGENTS.md content and does not duplicate any block
Leaves exactly one Git workflow, one Code comments and one Engineering principles section

check.cmd: cd existing && test "$(grep -c '^## Git workflow' AGENTS.md)" = 1 && test "$(grep -c '^## Code comments' AGENTS.md)" = 1 && test "$(grep -c '^# Engineering principles' AGENTS.md)" = 1

cases.prompt: Onboard the repo in legacy/ for agents; its AGENTS.md exists already, so merge into it.
expected_behavior: Adds the Git workflow, Code comments and Engineering principles sections to AGENTS.md
Does not add any new Karpathy-style block of its own

check.cmd: cd legacy && grep -q '^# Engineering principles' AGENTS.md && grep -q '^## Git workflow' AGENTS.md

cases.prompt: New repo, can you set up the AGENTS.md, cursor rules and cursorignore so agents behave consistently across tools?
Break this defined feature (CSV export with column selection) into engineering tickets with acceptance criteria.
